messages:
tess: psa: CS flagged a customer whose Console shows doubled quota after they started sending x-redwood-project header alongside org-scoped API keys. quick sanity check?

omar: can you paste a minimal repro?

tess: yep:

```
POST /v1/complete
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer sk-org-zzz,
  x-redwood-org: org_bigco,
  x-redwood-project: proj_sidecar
}
```

Console displays quota{owner=org_bigco} and quota{token_origin=sk-org-zzz} and the total widget sums both. customer panicked.

jin: sounds like telemetry emits both owner and token_origin. Console used to collapse by owner but recent refactor left both visible and aggregated.

maria: for billing we must have a single canonical owner per request. Proposal: pipeline add attr_owner enum: "project:proj_sidecar" > "org:org_bigco" > "legacy:key:sk-xxx". Keep raw token_origin for debugging but exclude from billing rollups.

sam: agree. UX change: add a small "canonical view" toggle on the quota dashboard (default on). If you turn off canonical view, show raw dimensions including token_origin. Also show a yellow "compat" pill when charts mix pre/post changes.

tess: rough rollout plan?

jin: pipeline change -> canary (5%). console change behind feature flag. billing queries use billing_view=compat for 30 days so invoices don't shift. unit tests: synthetic request must increment only one canonical series.

omar: add a runbook note: if a customer reports a discrepancy, check whether their keys are legacy (no project binding) and whether they received the new pipeline.

deploy-bot: queued: telemetry-owner-attr canary -> 5% traffic.

maria: i'll open the pipeline PR and a console flag PR. pinging @jin @sam for reviews. will coordinate CS message.

sam: good. also add a small alert to detect any invoice delta >0.2% during migration.

tess: thanks team. posting PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
